messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-09-16] handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway: The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder today; Oskar Lind wrote up the handover doc for Diego.
- [2025-07-29] standup/ember/2025-07-29: Policy: every auth-gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-02-18] standup/ember/2025-02-18: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-01-30] standup/cinder/2026-01-30: We agreed today that auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. The reason is that the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-12-29] standup/cinder/2025-12-29: Reminder: auth-gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-06-09] handover/2025-06-09-billing-api: The Ember team handed billing-api to Boreal today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Lena Fischer.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-2: The Dune team noticed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-09-03] standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.
- [2025-08-07] incident-review/INC-2025-017: INC-2025-017 review. What happened: auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. Why: an expired intermediate certificate. Follow-up decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-12-19] handover/2025-12-19-catalog: Atlas is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2025-11-26] handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer: The Atlas team is taking over the image resizer from the Ember team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-02-11] handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags: The Ember team handed the flags service to the Dune team today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.

Question: Who owns auth-gateway today?

message.reasoning: The auth gateway was owned by Ember as of 2025-01-20. Then on 2025-09-16, Ember handed the authentication gateway to Cinder. No later entries about auth-gateway ownership changes. Today is 2026-06-30, so the owner is Cinder.
